text: It is generally best to review and manually reconcile bank account transactions one day or week at a time. This can be done by selecting a date range for the **Posted Date** field in the Find Options dialog. To view only transactions that have not yet been reconciled select '**Y**' for the **Only Not Rec** field in the Find Options dialog. If you're looking for a specific bank account transaction you can search by various other fields as well.
